auth.description:
1. Follow the [Azure app creation guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/quickstart-register-app#register-an-application) and set the **Redirect URI** to {{redirectUrl}}.
2. Under **API permissions**, add **Dynamics CRM > user_impersonation (Delegated)**.
3. Copy your environment URL from **Power Platform admin center > Environments > (your environment) > Environment URL**. It must start with **https://**, for example **https://yourorg.crm.dynamics.com**, with no trailing slash.
auth.props.hostUrl.description: The full address of your Dynamics 365 environment, including **https://** and without a trailing slash, for example **https://yourorg.crm.dynamics.com**. Without https:// Microsoft rejects the sign-in with error AADSTS70011.
auth.props.proxyUrl.description: Keep empty if not needed. Optional proxy URL used for establishing connections when proxying requests is needed. For example: **https://proxy.com:8080**.
auth.props.tenantId.description: You can find this in the Azure portal.
